rongmei.title: Ai rui tikgun daihna neila bamni

lines: 1. Ai rui tikgun daina neila bamni,
Rih ping pui tuang mak pui ram khou 9!@;
Hei kandih khou rui phang hou tang ngam mak ,
Miram tang khang 9!@ nkhuan ngam mak.
Chorus:
Tingmik thui jaoni ai guang tang maksan,
Njianloumei gaipui ram khou 9!@;
Mei guaina rui hei 9!@ ning thuk sini,
Sangam mak ge ai karam gai 9!@.
2. Kabumang rianra na man kanmei le,
Khrista jian loumei ringpui lat hei;
Aniuta tithai lou puijang khou rui,
Hallelujah! Thuanku tak lak khe.
3. Hei kum pui kankhou jat kapum ma rui,
Katik kagun daimei bampang khou:
Kanloumeipu katik kagun daina,
Hou pui kankhou lumlou puni the.
4. Kandih rianrapui bam khou bamsan hei,
Tingmik thui rianramei rui duamliam;
Kanloumeipu hukhou dingpui kan khou,
Rianramei rui neilamei suni.
5. Hei kumma kanloumei lumloumei nun,
Tingsei lauthuan ganphiu gan gaimei;
Akhang suni poubaumei njianmei,
Tingsang neilamei lu suan bamni,
